stories.title: CISA Adds Six Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
stories.summary: CISA has added six new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders should treat this as an immediate exposure-management priority, confirm whether affected systems are internet-facing, review available indicators, and apply verified vendor mitigations or updates.

stories.title: Siemens Desigo, Gridscale
stories.summary: View CSAF Summary On October 21, 2026, the Node.js project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js, commonly referred to as "Node2Shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-111497).
stories.why_it_matters: Organizations should inventory potentially affected products, review the original advisory and prioritize the available security update, and monitor for credible exploitation evidence.

stories.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
